# Gaia GIS

Turn geographic data into maps, analytical notebooks, and print-ready deliverables with Gaia GIS, the self-hosted web GIS.

Gaia GIS is self-hosted: you install it on your own computer or servers. There is no hosted service. Access to the application packages is given on request. Gaia reads external WMS and WFS services and does not publish them.
